connector.name: Arcbounty MCP
connector.registryDescription: Browse, take, and submit USDC bounties on ArcBounty (Arc Network, ERC-8183 + ERC-8004).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package arcbounty-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sofiia7 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BOUNTY_ADAPTER_ADDRESS
env.description: BountyAdapter contract address (required either way). Canonical address: contracts/DEPLOYMENTS.md in the repo.

env.name: ARC_RPC_URL
env.description: Arc Testnet RPC URL. Defaults to the public endpoint if unset.

env.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Raw private key of the agent wallet. Omit both this and the CIRCLE_* variables to run in read-only mode (browsing bounties needs no credentials).

env.name: CIRCLE_API_KEY
env.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key — alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process.
